svg.text: #593 Enterprise K8s GPU Scheduling: Hardware MIG vs. CUDA MPS vs. Time-Slicing & Kueue TAS
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · Pack 42 Small/Dev Services + 4× 70B Pools onto 16× H100 (vs. 38× H100 Whole-GPU, -57.9% Cost)
1. Three Fractional GPU Sharing Mechanisms on K8s
A. Hardware MIG (Multi-Instance GPU: 1g.10gb / 2g.20gb / 3g.40gb)
• Hardware-isolated SMs, L2 cache crossbar & HBM memory controllers (Up to 7 slices)
• P99 Tail Jitter: <1.5% · Zero cross-tenant OOM blast radius [PRODUCTION PRIMARY]
B. CUDA MPS (Multi-Process Service / HAMi Soft-Memory Quota)
• Arbitrary SM % (e.g., 25%/75%) without rigid MIG partition boundaries (+18% density)
• Shared GPU fault domain (1 Xid page fault kills all co-located processes) → Single-Tenant Sidecars
C. Time-Slicing (Context-Switch Oversubscription)
• Zero HBM memory isolation (1 OOM crashes all pods) + 25–40ms context-switch stalls
• Strictly restrict to non-SLA Jupyter notebooks & CI smoke tests
2. K8s AI Scheduler Selection & Packing ROI
1. K8s Native Kueue + Topology-Aware Scheduling (TAS) + K8s 1.32+ DRA
• Gang-schedules multi-node training/PD pods within the same NVLink/Leaf switch domain
• Native Cohort borrowing + preemption between Online Inference & Nightly Batch
2. CNCF Volcano + HAMi (vGPU Fractional Memory & SM Scheduler)
• Best open-source fine-grained vGPU memory enforcement on non-MIG GPUs (L40S / A10)
• Intercepts cuMemAlloc via LD_PRELOAD to enforce strict MB-level container quotas
3. Enterprise Packing Benchmark (28 Small Services + 14 Dev Pods + 4× 70B)
• Whole-GPU Allocation: 28 + 6 + 4 = 38× H100 ($87,400/mo · 31% Avg SM Util)
3. Solution Architect Hardware-to-Sharing Rulebook
• On H100/H200/B200: Use Hardware MIG (1g.10gb / 2g.20gb) for multi-tenant small models (Embedding, Reranker, Whisper, Guardrails).
• On L40S (which lacks hardware MIG): Use HAMi / MPS with strict cuMemAlloc interception for trusted co-located inference pipelines.
